newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel-Some heads into cracked mkt.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel-Some heads into cracked mkt.

text.p: The oversupply of Russian straight-run fuel oil has resulted in an overflow into the cracked market and could ease recent bearish pressure, traders said.
An M-100 cargo was sold at $109 cif ARA and at least three straight-run cargoes are heading into the ARA barge market.

E-4 have been more resistant to the pull downwards and were seen commanding around formula +$2-3. Low sulphur straight-run failed to entice any European buyers and looked softer with easier crude. But at around the mid $120s fob NWE, the price remains a touch high for the U.S. -- London +44 171 542 8980
